description: Eisenbahnstrecken im Landkreis Osnabrück is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoinfo.lkos.de. Railway lines serve to connect points on their own railway body, with standard track; two or more tracks, avoiding strong curves, larger inclines and road intersections at the same height. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Railway lines in the district of Osnabrück" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Streckennetz, Bahn, Gleis, opendata. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
